title: Croatian Cheese Baked Casserole
description: A delicious and savory baked casserole filled with Croatian cheese, perfect for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Pasta
ingredients.notes: any type of pasta works well

instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pasta, tomato mixture, and Croatian cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with breadcrumbs.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
